questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Calvary and Southern Cross Care are close competitors and there are not many alternatives.

Do Calvary’s residential aged care facilities (Calvary Riverside Views and Calvary Sandhill) compete closely with Southern Cross Care’s residential aged care facilities (Glenara Lakes and Mount Esk) in the Launceston area? Please explain your response.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Calvary and/or Southern Cross Care.
